description: This file provides localization strings in Indonesian for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines messages for errors, input constraints, loading data, maximum selections, no results, and searching indicators used by the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the Indonesian message for data loading errors.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating how many characters to delete when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message indicating how many characters to add when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while more data is being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of choices that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no matching data is found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching data.
